blind.description: A compact cluster of four faceted, prismatic orange crystal shards of varying heights growing upward and slightly outward from a small base of dark grey rubble. Surfaces are solid, smooth, and cleanly faceted in a stylized hand-painted art style with warm amber and gold tones. The underside sits flat on the floor.
blind.from_above: Resembles an X-shaped or four-petaled arrangement of pointed faceted orange crystal tips meeting at a dark grey rocky center.
blind.extra_base_or_ground: small cluster of dark grey rocks/gravel
blind.height_vs_figure: Around 1/4 the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure (approximately 1.3 to 1.5 ft tall) and about 1.2 ft wide across the crystals.
